package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"os"

	"github.com/gopernicus/gopernicus/pockets/authorization"
	"github.com/gopernicus/gopernicus/pockets/authorization/logic/decisions"
	"github.com/gopernicus/gopernicus/pockets/authorization/logic/model"
	"github.com/gopernicus/gopernicus/pockets/authorization/logic/relationships"
	"github.com/gopernicus/gopernicus/pockets/authorization/logic/tuples"
	"github.com/gopernicus/gopernicus/pockets/authorization/stores/memory"
	"github.com/gopernicus/gopernicus/sdk/pkg/list"
)

func must(err error) { if err != nil { panic(err) } }
func main() {
	ctx:=context.Background()
	store:=memory.NewTuples()
	principal:=model.PrincipalRef{Type:"user",ID:"alice"}
	fact:=tuples.Tuple{Scope:tuples.On("doc","one"), Relation:"viewer", Subject:tuples.SubjectRef{Type:"user",ID:"alice"}}
	second:=fact
	second.Scope.ID="two"
	must(store.ApplyTuples(ctx,tuples.Changes{Add:[]tuples.Tuple{fact,second}}))
	page,err:=store.ListTuples(ctx,tuples.Query{},list.Request{Limit:1})
	must(err)
	if page.NextCursor=="" {panic("missing continuation")}
	cur,err:=list.DecodeCursor(page.NextCursor,"tuple_key")
	must(err)
	badPK,err:=list.EncodeCursor("tuple_key",cur.OrderValue,"different-key")
	must(err)
	_,badPKErr:=store.ListTuples(ctx,tuples.Query{},list.Request{Limit:1,Cursor:badPK})
	oldField,err:=list.EncodeCursor("role_key",cur.OrderValue,cur.PK)
	must(err)
	_,oldFieldErr:=store.ListTuples(ctx,tuples.Query{},list.Request{Limit:1,Cursor:oldField})
	policy:=decisions.Model{ResourceTypes:map[string]decisions.ResourceTypeDef{"doc":{
		Relations:map[string]decisions.RelationDef{"viewer":{AllowedSubjects:[]decisions.SubjectTypeRef{{Type:"user"}}}},
		Permissions:map[string]decisions.Expression{"read":decisions.Any(decisions.Direct("viewer"),decisions.Role("admin"))},
	}}}
	service,err:=decisions.NewService(store,decisions.WithModel(policy));must(err)
	result,err:=service.Check(ctx,model.CheckRequest{Principal:principal,Permission:"read",Resource:model.Resource{Type:"doc",ID:"one"}});must(err)
	other:=memory.New()
	separate:=memory.New()
	components,err:=authorization.New(authorization.Repositories{Tuples:other.Tuples(),Relationships:separate.Relationships()},authorization.WithModel(policy));must(err)
	must(components.RelationshipWriter.CreateRelationships(ctx,[]relationships.CreateRelationship{{ResourceType:"doc",ResourceID:"one",Relation:"viewer",SubjectType:"user",SubjectID:"alice"}}))
	read,err:=components.Decisions.Check(ctx,model.CheckRequest{Principal:principal,Permission:"read",Resource:model.Resource{Type:"doc",ID:"one"}});must(err)
	must(json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(map[string]any{
		"memory_accepts_mismatched_cursor_pk":badPKErr==nil,
		"memory_accepts_old_cursor_field":oldFieldErr==nil,
		"mixed_policy_check_allows":result.Allowed,
		"reported_permissions_for_viewer":service.GetPermissionsForRelation("doc","viewer"),
		"separate_authorities_constructor_accepted":true,
		"relationship_write_visible_to_decisions":read.Allowed,
	}))
}
